answer: The design leans on hardware TEE attestation, reduced by each unverified claim, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short. Work waits on the hollow until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the onyx of the next round. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work. The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy.
